_meta.note: BenchmarkEncryptInPlace now reuses its payload buffer, matching the forwarder's arena-backed reuse, so it measures the cipher not the allocator. BenchmarkEncryptInPlaceWithAlloc covers the allocating caller. The previous 908ns baseline was inflated by a per-iteration make() and is not comparable.
